ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Figure 8 shows the changes in cultivated land area and grain output in Anhui Province from 2000 to 2010, and Figure 9 shows the structure of crop sown area in Anhui Province in 2000 and 2010. Complete the question. <image1> According to the figures, what kind of support is another main reason why Anhui Province’s grain output generally showed an upward trend from 2000 to 2010?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In Figure 8, although the line for grain output in Anhui Province from 2000 to 2010 fluctuates, it generally shows an upward trend; it was relatively low in 2003, then generally recovered afterward, and generally rose after 2005. During the same period, the line for cultivated land area also fluctuated, but overall it did not increase significantly, and even declined slightly compared with around 2000. In Figure 9, the proportion of sown area for grain crops rose from 66.1% in 2000 to 73.1% in 2010. Then reason: The overall increase in grain output cannot mainly be attributed to an increase in cultivated land area; an increase in agricultural labor is also not a factor directly reflected in the figures. Combined with the original options in the question stem, apart from government policy support, another main reason that can support the improvement of grain yield per unit area and output growth is progress in agricultural science and technology, so the answer is technological support.
